# Sprint Review Report

**Generated by Horseless Carriage v0.1.0** (Interaction Level: Product)

## Summary
Sprint 6 commenced with resolving a blocking release PR. We initiated development on the Admin Dashboard, implementing an initial UI and HTTP networking layer, but development halted when the sprint budget of 5M tokens was exceeded before the work could reach the Accepted stage. No user stories were fully delivered this sprint. A technical impediment regarding executable permissions on gradlew was identified, as well as process issues with the Product Owner attempting to reprioritize stories mid-sprint.

## Accomplishments
- Resolved the release PR blocking issue from the previous sprint.
- Started work on the Admin Dashboard Job Submission and Status Pipeline View, including a Compose for Desktop UI and Ktor HTTP client, and added a Gradle wrapper.
